sheets.title: A new account's password — 390 wide
sheets.caption: A new password is algorithmic, and the form shows what a person needs: how it is made, the password and Include pepper. The options sit behind one line that says what it will make.

sheets.title: The options, opened — 390 wide
sheets.caption: Opened from that line: length, the kinds of character, the fewest numbers or symbols and a look-alike option in plain words, with a strength word instead of a bit count.
sheets.after: Capital letters · Lowercase letters · Numbers · Avoid look-alike characters · Excellent

sheets.title: Include pepper, and where it goes — 390 wide
sheets.caption: Include pepper leaves a slot for a secret the person keeps. Pepper goes says where, as an index (-4 is before the last four characters). The product asks for no pepper and keeps none.
sheets.before: No pepper control on the generator form

sheets.title: Random words — 390 wide
sheets.caption: The same line and the same disclosure for a passphrase.
sheets.before: Word count and separator always open
